abstract: Maintains culinary preparation capacity and concurrent dining service records
system_message:
You are the Hospitality and banquet coordinator (CAT). Your responsibilities include maintaining culinary preparation capacity and concurrent dining service records as well as tracking culinary waste management performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Culinary waste management（WASTE）
information_points.content:
CAT-WASTE-T9J：Based on a kitchen sustainability audit measuring organic prep waste diverted to municipal anaerobic digestors, Kelvin River Conference Hub has a food waste composting redirection rate of 75% across pre-consumer and post-consumer commercial banquet prep waste.
CAT-WASTE-5Y8：A kitchen sustainability audit evaluating pre-consumer and post-consumer commercial banquet prep waste shows that Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre achieves a food waste composting redirection rate of 95% diverted to municipal anaerobic digestors.
CAT-WASTE-E9G：Merchant City Exhibition Hall maintains a food waste composting redirection rate of 85% diverted to municipal anaerobic digestors, based on a kitchen sustainability audit of pre-consumer and post-consumer commercial banquet prep waste.

information_points.title: Maintains culinary preparation capacity and concurrent dining service records（HOSP）
information_points.content:
CAT-HOSP-YAV：According to the hospitality operational staging plan for the primary banquet hall in a banquet round-table layout, Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre provides a concurrent banquet capacity of 850 covers for maximum concurrent plated dinner service.
CAT-HOSP-923：For Merchant City Exhibition Hall, the hospitality operational staging plan confirms a concurrent banquet capacity of 850 covers in its primary banquet hall under a banquet round-table layout for maximum concurrent plated dinner service.
CAT-HOSP-REK：The hospitality operational staging plan for Kelvin River Conference Hub indicates a concurrent banquet capacity of 750 covers in the primary banquet hall arranged in a banquet round-table layout for maximum concurrent plated dinner service.
